title: Simjulation GM vulnerability reproductions
method: Actually executed with Node.js 22 and the globally installed TypeScript transpiler through an isolated CommonJS require hook; no npm packages were installed. These are custom direct-engine calls, not Vitest.

reproductions.title: NPC death by poisoning bypasses the dies guard
reproductions.expected: The NPC remains alive unless an explicitly authorised engine mechanic resolves the death.

observed.event: Mikumo Raizen dies (Li poisons Raizen at dinner)

reproductions.sourceInspectionOfPR5: The limited verb guard in engine/gm.ts still does not include poison/poisons. Add a regression test on the current head.

reproductions.title: A non-lethal fight with a made-up farmhand awarded Kogashira head and merit
reproductions.setup: Started GM game, put Li in service, advanced to day index 261 (scheduled raid day), then submitted an officer-tagged fight with a random farmhand.
reproductions.playerMoves: Repeated the engine's 'feint' move until the duel ended.

observed.duelResult: Li WON against the random farmhand

reproductions.expected: A practice/non-lethal win must never award an officer's head or officer-kill merit.
reproductions.sourceInspectionOfPR5: engine/gm.ts gmDuelStart still derives officer merit/head without checking f.deadly. Current head uses a new canonical raid-officer substitution, so the exact old reproduction must be adapted and run on PR #5.

reproductions.title: Raid officer selection may not require Li to be at the ford
reproductions.evidence: Current build/stage-1 commit fb6aae37b2e5de8ea4f5b13af2c85dbf4e0a5792: fightFacts selects raidOfficerOn(today(s)) and uses the date/flags, without an obvious location eligibility condition.
reproductions.nextTest: On a scheduled raid day, place Li away from the ford and submit an officer fight. Assert no ford officer substitution/reward outside the authorised location.

reproductions.title: Narrative victory fact-checker uses a limited verb list
reproductions.evidence: Current build/stage-1 commit fb6aae37b2e5de8ea4f5b13af2c85dbf4e0a5792: engine/factcheck.ts checkGmScene checks a finite list of victory verbs and may miss phrases such as 'Li won the spar'. Full pipeline bypass not yet executed.
reproductions.nextTest: Without a duel-end event, check 'Li won the spar against Gonza', 'Li punches Gonza to the ground', and other equivalent language.
